description: Defines what a co-applicant is, when to add one, and what consent is required in a Water Licence Application.

knowledge_items.title: What Is a Co-Applicant
knowledge_items.content: A co-applicant is an individual or company/organization listed on the title of the land, mine, or undertaking who was not previously identified as the principal applicant.

knowledge_items.title: When Should You Add a Co-Applicant
knowledge_items.content: Add a co-applicant if someone else also has legal rights or responsibility for the land, water use, or works in this application.
examples: More than one person owns the land.
Another person or organization has rights to use the water.
Another person or organization is responsible for the water works.

knowledge_items.title: Written Consent Is Required
knowledge_items.content: If you add a co-applicant, each person must provide written consent. The co-applicant must follow the consent form template and upload a signed copy. No system-generated form is provided.

reference.note: See the co-applicant authorization letter template for the required format.

knowledge_items.title: Co-Applicant Is Not Always Required
knowledge_items.content: If it is only you, you can continue without adding a co-applicant.
